| Category = Beef recipes
| Difficulty = 3
}}

{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
* 2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoons]] cracked [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]]
* ½ teaspoon [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 2 cloves [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]], [[Cookbook:Mincing|minced]]
* 4 [[Cookbook:Beef#Loin|beef tenderloin]] steaks, 1 [[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] (2.5 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]]) thick
* Non-stick [[Cookbook:Cooking Spray|cooking spray]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] thinly-[[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]] [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], separated into rings
* ⅔ cup dry [[Cookbook:Red Wine|red wine]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] steak sauce

== Procedure ==
# Combine pepper, salt, and minced garlic in a small bowl; rub both sides of each steak with this mixture. 
# Place steaks on a broiler pan coated with cooking spray; [[Cookbook:Broiling|broil]] 5 minutes on each side or until desired degree of doneness. Set aside; keep warm. 
# Place a medium nonstick [[Cookbook:Skillet|skillet]] coated with cooking spray over medium-high heat. Add onion to skillet; cover and cook 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. 
# Remove onion from skillet; set aside, and keep warm. 
# Add wine to skillet, scraping pan to loosen the browned bits. Cook over medium-high heat until reduced to ⅓ cup (about 1 minute), and stir in steak sauce. 
# Spoon wine sauce over steaks, and top with onion. Serve with [[Cookbook:French Fries|French fries]].
